title: AI ASCII Art
description: Transforms the photo into highly detailed ASCII character art.
positive_prompt: Transform the input photo into highly detailed ASCII character art. Reconstruct the entire image exclusively from uniformly spaced monospaced characters, punctuation marks, and typographic symbols arranged on a precise character grid. Use variations in glyph density, character shapes, and spacing to represent brightness, shadows, contours, textures, and fine details. Create an authentic computer-terminal aesthetic with crisp light-gray, white, or phosphor-green glyphs on a dark background. Maintain impressive visual readability at normal viewing size while preserving the unmistakable structure of the original photograph. Every recognizable image feature must be constructed from visible character glyphs rather than smooth drawn lines. Rendering contract: Use the input image as visual ground truth. Treat the input photo as the exact structural reference. Preserve the exact number of subjects and their left-to-right order, relative scale, pose, gaze directions, primary objects, and environmental composition. For every visible person, retain recognizable face geometry, distinguishing features, hairstyles, and proportions in a style-appropriate monospaced ASCII form; do not beautify, age, or swap identity unless explicitly requested. Keep the original perspective, framing, and aspect ratio. Use only abstract glyph arrangements that function as image pixels, not readable words or sentences. Apply the transformation consistently across the entire scene into one coherent static ASCII artwork with a consistent monospaced grid. Return one coherent finished image, not a before-and-after comparison, split screen, or unintended collage, with no external interface, captions, letters, numerals, logos, signatures, watermarks, or terminal window decorations.
negative_prompt: photographic textures, smooth illustrations, conventional line drawings, vector shapes, 3D models, painted surfaces, emoji art, inconsistent font sizes, proportional fonts, random character placement, illegible subject silhouettes, excessive empty space, recognizable words, sentences, captions, logos, watermarks, corrupted glyphs, changed identity, missing subjects, additional people, duplicated faces, wrong perspective, split screen, terminal window decorations, identity drift, face swap, altered age, altered skin tone, wrong subject count, extra people, duplicated subject, merged subjects, inconsistent transformation, partial transformation, before-and-after, unintended collage, accidental crop, cut-off face, malformed anatomy, broken hands, fused fingers, extra limbs, incoherent perspective, floating objects, random text, gibberish letters, numerals, signature, interface elements
custom_prompt_placeholder: e.g. green terminal phosphor, dense monospaced glyphs...
